Complete Cooking Mechanics Guide: Effects, Duration, and Critical Success
🍳 料理攻略
🍳 Cooking Guide
料理不是把食材往锅里一扔就行：效果冲突、时长上限、暴击规则，搞懂这三条，做出来的料理才值那个价。
Cooking isn't just throwing ingredients into a pot: effect conflicts, duration caps, and critical-success rules — understand these three, and your dishes will be worth their ingredients.

本站已有料理合成表和四大神级料理配方，本篇不重复列配方，只讲机制：为什么有时候做出来只有回血、为什么时长总是不够、什么时候一定能大成功。

This site already has a cooking recipes table and the four god-tier cooking recipes, so this guide does not repeat recipes — it only explains the mechanics: why a dish sometimes only restores health, why the duration is never enough, and when a critical success is guaranteed.
机制搞懂了，任何配方都能自己配。
Once you understand the mechanics, you can create any recipe yourself.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key Points of This Guide
一锅最多放 5 个食材；一 dish 只能有一种效果，混两种效果会互相抵消，只剩回血。
A pot holds at most 5 ingredients; one dish can have only one effect — mixing two effects cancels them out, leaving only health recovery.
效果时长是各食材时长相加，上限 30 分钟；任一龙的犄角都能把时长拉到 30 分钟。
Effect duration is the sum of each ingredient's duration, capped at 30 minutes; any dragon's horn can push the duration to 30 minutes.
大成功（暴击）三选一：额外回血、时长 +5 分钟、效果等级 +1。
A critical success offers one of three bonuses: extra health recovery, +5 minutes of duration, or +1 effect level.
平时暴击率低，金苹果等食材可必暴；血月夜 23:30 起做料理必大成功。
The critical rate is normally low, but Golden Apples and similar ingredients can guarantee a crit; cooking from 23:30 on a Blood Moon night always critically succeeds.
怪物精华会让效果随机，且不能大成功；生命类食材超量部分会变成黄心。
Monster Extract makes the effect random and prevents critical success; excess recovery from Hearty ingredients becomes temporary yellow hearts.

常见问题
FAQ
一锅最多放 5 个食材，这是硬上限。更重要的是效果规则：一 dish 只能有一种效果。如果你同时放了加攻击的食材和加防御的食材，两种效果会互相抵消，最后只剩回血，等于白白浪费了效果食材。配料理的第一步永远是先定效果：攻击、防御、精力、耐寒、耐热、潜行，一次只选一种。

A pot holds at most 5 ingredients — that is a hard cap. More important is the effect rule: one dish can have only one effect. If you put in both attack-boosting and defense-boosting ingredients, the two effects cancel each other out, leaving only health recovery and wasting the effect ingredients. The first step in cooking is always to settle on one effect: attack, defense, stamina, cold resistance, heat resistance, or stealth — only one at a time.

The first step in cooking is always to settle on one effect: attack, defense, stamina, cold resistance, heat resistance, or stealth — only one at a time.
效果时长是锅里各食材的时长相加得到的，但上限是 30 分钟，加再多也不会超过。
Effect duration is the sum of the durations of the ingredients in the pot, but it is capped at 30 minutes — adding more will not exceed it.
如果你想做一锅管半小时的料理，最简单的办法是放任一龙的犄角：龙角能直接把时长拉到 30 分钟，省下其他食材位去堆效果等级或回血。

If you want a dish that lasts half an hour, the simplest way is to add any dragon's horn: a dragon horn pushes the duration straight to 30 minutes, freeing the other ingredient slots for stacking effect level or health recovery.
龙素材的刷法见本站四条龙素材刷取指南。
For how to farm dragon materials, see this site's Four Dragons Material Farming Guide.

Cooking ingredient combinations in the pot

做料理有时会大成功，也就是暴击，效果三选一：额外回血、时长 +5 分钟、效果等级 +1。
Cooking sometimes critically succeeds — a critical success — with one of three bonuses: extra health recovery, +5 minutes of duration, or +1 effect level.
平时暴击率很低，属于随缘；
Normally the crit rate is very low, so it is a matter of luck;
但有两个必暴条件要记住：用金苹果等特定食材可以必暴，更实用的是血月夜——23:30 起在血月之夜做料理必定大成功。

But remember two guaranteed-crit conditions: specific ingredients such as Golden Apples can guarantee a crit, and more usefully, on a Blood Moon night, cooking from 23:30 onward always critically succeeds.
需要批量做高级料理时，等到血月夜再开锅最划算，血月机制详见本站血月机制全解。

When you need to cook high-level dishes in bulk, waiting until a Blood Moon night to start cooking is the most efficient approach; for Blood Moon mechanics, see this site's Complete Blood Moon Mechanics Guide.
怪物精华是个双刃剑：它能延长时长，但会让效果随机，而且放了怪物精华的料理不能大成功。想稳定出某种效果就别放精华；想赌一把长效料理再考虑它。生命类食材（比如大生命松露）回血超量部分会变成黄心，黄心是临时生命上限，适合进高难度战斗前吃。

Monster Extract is a double-edged sword: it can extend duration, but it makes the effect random, and a dish containing Monster Extract cannot critically succeed. If you want a specific effect reliably, don't add extract; only consider it if you want to gamble on a long-lasting dish. For Hearty ingredients (such as Big Hearty Truffles), recovery beyond your full health becomes yellow hearts — temporary extra maximum health, best eaten before a high-difficulty battle.

先定效果和场景：打 Boss 要攻击还是防御？进雪山要耐寒几级？
First, settle on the effect and the situation: against a boss, do you need attack or defense? Heading into the snowy mountains, what level of cold resistance do you need?
选 1 到 2 种同效果食材堆等级，剩下的位置补回血食材。
Pick 1 to 2 ingredients with the same effect to stack its level, and fill the remaining slots with health-recovery ingredients.
要长效就加龙角拉到 30 分钟；要批量暴击就等血月夜 23:30 后再做。
For a long-lasting dish, add a dragon horn to reach 30 minutes; for bulk critical successes, wait until after 23:30 on a Blood Moon night.
别混效果、别乱放怪物精华，做完先看效果再决定吃不吃。
Don't mix effects, don't add Monster Extract carelessly, and after cooking, check the effect before deciding whether to eat it.
